## 飞牛打包修复（本仓库） - **修复「点开 DSH 卡片打不开网页」**：`dsh web` 长时间运行会堆内存耗尽退出（日志 `Reached heap limit`，约 2 GB），而 gate 仍在 3080 上把浏览器 302 到已经没人监听的 3081，浏览器报「无法访问此网站」。 - 新增看门狗：每 10 秒检查 dsh 进程，退出即按同样参数重启并刷新启动令牌（gate 每次请求重读 `launch-token`，不必重启 gate）；连续失败退避到最多 5 分钟。`stop` 时先杀看门狗，避免刚停掉又被拉起。 - gate 在 302 之前探测 dsh 端口，不通就返回 503「DSH 正在重启」，不再把浏览器送到死端口。 - **修复重启后必定 401**：`wait_token` 原先从整个日志 grep 启动令牌，而日志是跨重启追加的 —— 重启后 dsh 还没打印新令牌，第一轮循环就命中上一轮的旧令牌。改为 spawn 前记录日志字节偏移，只扫描本次启动之后新增的部分。 - **修复「安装包大小校验失败」**：同一版本的 Release 资产以前是**原地覆盖**，而 fpk 每次构建的字节都不同，于是索引里记的大小/sha256 与线上文件对不上，飞牛安装时直接报 `expected=… actual=…`。现在产物名带内容指纹（sha256 前 12 位，如 `DSH_v0.2.2-alpha.2_amd64_8c0f1e407cba.fpk`），下载地址与内容绑定、永不改变；索引切换是原子提交，旧资产保留 1 小时后自动清理。 - **支持在 NAS 本机上访问**：dsh 只绑局域网 IP，`127.0.0.1` 上原本没人监听，在 NAS 本机开浏览器打不开。gate 现在额外监听 `127.0.0.1`，用 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` 即可（`localhost` 可能解析到 `::1`，不要用）。 - **新增访问日志**：gate 逐条记录访问（客户端地址、Host、路径、状态码，令牌打码）。排查「打不开」时看 `dsh.log` 里的 `[gate]` 行：没有记录=请求没到 NAS，503=正在重启，302 但打不开=卡在 3081。 ## 更新内容（同步自上游） [中文](#cn-v0.2.2-alpha.2-community) | [English](#en-v0.2.2-alpha.2-community)

Use fullscreen settings with horizontal navigation on narrow browsers, scroll focused tabs fully into view, and use 16px task text fields on touch devices. by @Stevring - Keep touch actions free from hover tooltips, expose Workspace and archived-result controls, and scroll wide Markdown tables within their own containers. by @Stevring - Fade overflowing header status actions in narrow conversation panes so utility buttons such as Open in app remain visible and clickable. by @turtle2099 - Restore automatic icon-only model selection in narrow composers while retaining the full model name in the menu. by @LegGasai - Fix font settings crowding their labels and descriptions on phones and narrow windows by stacking font fields while keeping size controls right-aligned. by @EricMoin - Distinguish same-named Workspaces with their shortest unique path suffix and prioritize that suffix on narrow screens. by @turtle2099 - Use DPR-aware inset outlines on shared buttons to stabilize fine borders at fractional sizes in Safari without changing layout. by @Stevring - Place running status at the active turn tail before queued steering messages, distinguishing active and pending input and reducing layout jitter. by @imccyu - Add resistance and spring-back when floating sidebar panels are dragged beyond screen edges, and keep their controls reachable when the window shrinks. by @yudshj - Close right-sidebar tabs with the middle mouse button without selecting background tabs, while preserving the protected start tab. by @Kingwl - Fix transcript jumps, scroll reversal, and blank gaps when expanding or folding work steps, while keeping running status visible. by @imccyu - Briefly highlight and fade the target line in code and text previews after opening a file-line link from chat. by @turtle2099 - Add raw JSON views of live tool results to Trajectory, displayed above rendered results. by @kermanx - Search prioritizes long Search API summaries for models, capped at 800 characters per source by default, while search cards retain short snippets. by @yudshj - Start the model picker with configured models selected, add or remove candidates while preserving custom values, and apply select-all only to visible candidates. by @turtle2099 - For models accessed through pi-ai that cannot accept additional system messages during a conversation, keep later system messages in place as reminders rather than moving them into the initial prompt. by @Tuyixiang - Reorder models within DeepSeek and pi-ai providers by dragging or using arrow keys, preserving order and complete model parameters when saved. by @Magolor - Show full truncated composer statistics in tooltips and include turn and step counts in Session statistics. by @turtle2099 - Improve history-context cache reuse across consecutive tool calls in Auto review to reduce repeated processing. by @turtle2099 - Background-job completion notices include small outputs and reduce duplicate notifications for already-read results and subagent closing messages. by @turtle1999 - Speed up first-time loading of lazy components such as the source editor in the Web preview. by @turtle2099 - Speed up file searches with literal directory prefixes by skipping unrelated directories while preserving results and ordering. by @kermanx - Pan images that exceed the viewport and transfer original files through in-app drag-and-drop or native desktop dragging. by @std4453 - Tell phone and tablet users when a file is opened on another device. Show failure notifications on all devices and keep successful desktop operations silent. by @Stevring ### Bug Fixes - Budget global and project AGENTS.md chains separately so project instructions do not evict global guidance; messages containing both chains can use up to twice maxBytes. by @ZiyaZhang - Compact history with the previous model before switching to a smaller context window; stop the switch request and preserve its previous header if compaction fails. by @Dudu-0223 - Preserve the required thought signatures in Gemini tool calls over OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and include them in subsequent requests to prevent rejection caused by missing signatures. by @turtle2099 - Reuse existing context-prefix caches for new model requests when the system prompt is unchanged, avoiding unnecessary cache invalidation. by @mektpoy - Hide Web search tools when required credentials are missing; fetch tools using the newer Web API also follow credential readiness. by @LegGasai - Preserve saved Auto permission and approval policy during application shutdown instead of unintentionally switching to Full access. by @tianyicui - User steering now releases a background-output wait immediately and returns current output without stopping the job. by @mektpoy - Fix delegation tools being temporarily unavailable after preset round trips and apply the current Agent’s tool restrictions to delegation. by @Dudu-0223 - Resume blocked goals from the Web goal bar; goals that have exhausted their round limit still require a higher limit first. by @turtle2099 - Save Session recovery records before model requests and tool execution in `sdk-minimal`. Show the current local Markdown image in newly rendered messages and previews after the file is overwritten. by @turtle2099 - Fix bare URLs incorrectly including following Chinese punctuation and text in links. by @turtle2099 - Preserve backslash separators in Windows-path Markdown links and images so they resolve to the intended location. by @turtle2099 - Include whole-turn deliveries and writes in deliverable cards and closing-reply file links, even after the reply; present guidance tells agents to link files before waiting for user input. by @yudshj - Fix prolonged page freezes caused by syntax highlighting of certain struct definitions. by @yudshj - Fix pasted file and folder paths being highlighted only through their directory prefixes in the composer. by @turtle2099 - Pause the chat running clock during disconnection or reconnection and resume elapsed-time display after reconnecting. by @turtle2099 - Keep retained steering and follow-up input in log order before assistant output in Trajectory, including after refresh and history loading. by @kermanx - Use isolated, theme-backed sidebar drag previews to avoid capturing content behind rows while preserving native reordering. by @Stevring - Make settings-navigation hover visible in dark mode while retaining selected-state priority. by @turtle2099 - Expand and collapse long questions and option descriptions in place, with navigation and submission controls kept visible. by @yudshj - Prevent a window-activating click on a Session title from accidentally opening rename on macOS, while preserving normal double-click rename. by @turtle2099 - Preserve the sidebar file-tab strip's scroll position when selecting, opening, or closing tabs instead of restarting from the left edge. by @turtle2099 - Run ordinary conversation forks independently instead of treating them as subagents, while preserving creator relationships for real subagents. by @Dudu-0223 - Use SSH for self-hosted Git plugin installation when HTTPS is unreadable and SSH is available. by @turtle2099 - Offer script approval and retry when installing Git plugins with prepare scripts instead of reporting only an unknown error. by @turtle2099 - Approval messages explicitly state whether user approval is requested, avoiding ambiguity around the never policy. by @turtle2099 - Prevent history expansion from rewriting exclamation marks or causing persistent Bash command timeouts on macOS. by @grllll - Tell the model to continue after a skipped question without asking it again or treating the skip as permission. by @turtle2099 - Keep skills from healthy roots available when another skill root cannot be read, and report incomplete discovery. by @Dudu-0223 - Resolve configuration-project plugins using the project’s ESM rules for dependency subpaths, package imports, and self-references. by @shigma - Allow Web Fetch to read valid UTF-8 pages whose encoding declarations contain multiple labels including UTF-8. by @Dudu-0223 - Fix tool calls failing on unambiguous optional arguments by accepting an empty grep include. by @turtle1999 - Fix restricted sandbox commands failing to start when DSH runs as administrator or in Windows Sandbox, while preserving file-write and deletion restrictions. by @huoyaoyuan - Correct the Windows installed-app publisher and keep the application name separate from its version in uninstall listings. by @winewill - Improve Windows installer progress rendering, dragging, and activation, restore native minimize transitions, and trigger caption buttons on release inside the original button. by @winewill - Exit the Desktop Host immediately after acknowledging completed teardown so leftover event-loop handles do not block update installation. by @turtle2099 - Leave macOS fullscreen before Desktop update confirmation so failed installs recover the workspace; preserve tasks and show retry guidance if fullscreen exit times out. by @winewill - Show desktop update prompts in-window without raising native child windows for background results, and match prompts to the app’s light or dark theme. by @winewill - Keep conversation header menus close to their trigger buttons on macOS desktop. by @turtle2099 - Fix the native macOS directory picker initially appearing inactive and ignoring directory clicks. by @EricMoin ### Chores - Raise the minimum supported Node.js version to 24.9. Upgrade older Node.js runtimes before upgrading DSH. by @tianyicui - Provide SDK file delivery, questions, scheduling, skills, and context capabilities consistent with Web mode, with question callbacks and operation approval. by @koalazf99 - Fix event publication and cleanup around Session creation, recovery, and disposal. Make initialization events available to live subscribers and wait for acquired resources to finish cleanup on cancellation. by @kermanx - Add independent Session APIs to read snapshots and continuously subscribe to Session event logs, execution state, and event-projection data. by @imccyu - Migrate custom plugins to asynchronous retained Session-projection handles. Legacy registration disposers and key-based reads retain compatibility with deprecation notices; approval-state recovery requires the composition to provide sessionProjections and await service activation. by @kermanx, @Magolor - Allow whole-unit JSON and SQLite storage to read explicitly declared compatible older versions and write in the current version format. by @Magolor - Allow Web Fetch to access non-public addresses for proxies and internal networks; deployments must restrict network access separately. by @turtle2099 - Synchronize Cordis Timer with its upstream implementation; custom plugins must adapt to changed return values. by @shigma - Provide unified Cordis Fiber access to raw configuration, candidate resolution, and effective configuration, used consistently by settings and hot reload. by @shigma - Retrieve diagnostic reports for desktop startup failures, including a bounded history of recent plugin operations to help troubleshooting. by @winewill - Add system and application permission onboarding to macOS Computer Use, support long clicks, and improve application launching. Retain application permissions across restarts. by @CreatixChu, @koalazf99 - Support experimental Auto review in Headless. by @tianyicui - Keep Ralph loop and Session search bundled, but no longer list them among experimental plugins. by @ZiyaZhang - Upgrade pi-ai to 1.3.0 with updated model catalogs, endpoints, and reasoning replay rules; malformed completed tool arguments fail the response before any tool executes. by @tianyicui - Default undeclared custom-model capacities to decimal 1M context and 128K output; smaller endpoints should set explicit capacities to avoid delayed compaction. by @LegGasai - Capture the step model before prompt assembly and pre-step and retain it through retries; plugins should select through agent.model rather than changing routes in agent/request. by @kermanx - Rename Custom plugin markets to Custom plugin indexes. Discover reads user-added index files, and index generation excludes private versions, tags, and default-branch packages. by @turtle2099, @turtle1999 - Official bundle lists are now exported by @deepseek-ai/dsh-official-bundles; custom integrations must update imports from app-boot. by @turtle2099 - Activate tools conditionally per step with consistent model declarations, PTC bindings, and execution admission. Plugins must migrate tools.resolve/executable and prompt-assembly integration. by @LegGasai - Add a VM Script mode to Node PTC with top-level await, dynamic imports, and expression results, plus optional state retention across calls. Per-call execution remains the default; top-level return and using are unsupported. by @kermanx - Split native and PTC tool execution into Agent-scoped plugins; enable PTC through configuration overlays and migrate tools.mode and DSH_TOOLS_MODE usage. by @kermanx - Move the PTC Node control channel to birpc; upgrade self-deployed bootstraps and SSH helpers together, with SSH protocol increasing from 2 to 3. by @kermanx - Report caller-cancelled run_code calls in PTC Mode as ABORTED rather than CODE_RUN_FAILED. SDK and Session consumers must update cancellation handling. by @kermanx Full Changelog: [dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4...dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4...dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2)
